entries.source_quote: Do not replace a device until a warranty check for that same case has returned active coverage. If there are several checks, use the most recent result.
canonical_bullets: Before replacing any device, check that the warranty is active for the SAME case.
Use the latest warranty-check result for that case. An earlier active result cannot override a later inactive result.

entries.source_quote: The service audit may be recorded only after a device replacement for that case has succeeded.
canonical_bullets: After a device has been replaced successfully, record a service audit for the SAME case. Do not record the audit before successful replacement.
